title: HTML Challenge: Resource Page
description: Build a resource page that has: a main heading, an intro paragraph, an unordered list with at least 3 links, an image with alt text, and a footer.
starterCode:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Resources</title>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Build your resource page here -->
  <!-- Requirements:
    1. An h1 heading
    2. A paragraph introducing the page
    3. A ul with at least 3 li items, each containing an <a> link
    4. An img with an alt attribute
    5. A footer
  -->
</body>
</html>
hints: The h1 goes inside body — give it a title like 'Learning Resources' or 'Useful Links'
For the links, use href="#" as a placeholder URL — the test just checks that <a> tags exist inside <li>
img needs both src and alt — use any image URL or src="photo.jpg" with a descriptive alt
footer goes at the bottom of body, after the list and image

tests.message: Page must have an h1 heading
Page must have at least one paragraph
Page must have an unordered list
List must have at least 3 items
Each list item must contain a link
The image must have an alt attribute
